﻿# Post Project Review

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../README.md) • [Governance](../README.md) • [Governing Bodies](./README.md)**

> Gate 6 governing body responsible for retrospective evaluation of project outcomes, lessons learned documentation, and continuous improvement to enhance future project success and governance effectiveness.

page_texts.2:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#governing-body-overview]

## Governing Body Overview

**Purpose**: Retrospective evaluation of project outcomes, lessons learned documentation, and continuous improvement to enhance future project success and governance effectiveness.

**Charter**: The Post Project Review (PPR) serves as the final governance gate, conducting comprehensive evaluation of project outcomes, business value realization, and process effectiveness. The PPR ensures that lessons learned are captured and incorporated into future projects and governance processes.

**Body Type**: Review and Advisory (evaluates outcomes and provides recommendations for continuous improvement)

**Gate Authority**: Gate 6 - Post Project Review Process in the 6-gate governance framework

**GainwellNow Enterprise Architecture Governance**: [Submit PPR Request](https://gainwellnow.service-now.com/esc?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=3d2faedac356ce908978decf050131f6)

---
page_texts.3:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#composition]

## Composition

| Role                          | Representative                                                 | Responsibilities                                                            | Participation |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- |
| **Chair**                     | EA Governance Coordinator (Rotating) or Senior Program Manager | Review oversight, lessons learned facilitation, improvement recommendations | Required      |
| **Enterprise Architecture**   | Principal Enterprise Architect/CTO                             | Strategic oversight and enterprise alignment                                | Required      |
| **Business Stakeholder**      | Primary Business Sponsor or Product Owner                      | Business value assessment, user experience evaluation                       | Required      |
| **Project Manager**           | Project or Program Manager                                     | Project execution assessment, process effectiveness review                  | Required      |
| **Technical Lead**            | Senior Architect or Technical Lead                             | Technical solution evaluation, architectural lessons learned                | Required      |
| **Operations Representative** | Operations Manager or Senior Engineer                          | Operational effectiveness assessment, support experience                    | As Needed     |
| **Finance Representative**    | Financial Analyst or Budget Owner                              | Financial performance assessment, cost-benefit analysis                     | As Needed     |
| **Quality Assurance**         | Process Improvement Specialist                                 | Quality metrics assessment, process improvement recommendations             | As Needed     |

**Meeting Frequency**: Scheduled 30-90 days after Product Go Live
**Decision Scope and Authority**: Project closure authorization, lessons learned documentation, process improvement recommendations

page_texts.5:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#required-information]

### Required Information

- **Project Performance Metrics**: Actual vs. planned performance across all key indicators
- **Business Value Realization**: Assessment of achieved business outcomes and benefits
- **Budget and Timeline Analysis**: Final cost and schedule performance analysis
- **Stakeholder Feedback**: Comprehensive feedback from users, business stakeholders, and technical teams
- **Operational Performance**: Post-deployment system performance and operational metrics
page_texts.6:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#decision-criteria]

### Decision Criteria

- **Business Value Achievement**: Verification that intended business outcomes were realized
- **Process Effectiveness**: Assessment of governance process efficiency and effectiveness
- **Quality Standards**: Evaluation of deliverable quality and standards compliance
- **Stakeholder Satisfaction**: Validation of stakeholder experience and satisfaction levels
- **Improvement Opportunities**: Identification of areas for future improvement

---
page_texts.8:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#primary-activities]

### Primary Activities

- **Outcome Assessment**: Comprehensive evaluation of project results against original objectives
- **Process Review**: Assessment of governance process effectiveness and efficiency
- **Lessons Learned Capture**: Documentation of key insights, successes, and challenges
- **Improvement Identification**: Recognition of opportunities for process and practice improvements
- **Knowledge Transfer**: Sharing of best practices and lessons with the broader organization
page_texts.9:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#key-deliverables]

### Key Deliverables

- **Project Closure Report**: Comprehensive assessment of project outcomes and performance
- **Lessons Learned Documentation**: Detailed documentation of key insights and recommendations
- **Process Improvement Recommendations**: Specific recommendations for governance process enhancements
- **Best Practices Documentation**: Capture of successful approaches and methodologies
- **Knowledge Base Updates**: Integration of lessons learned into organizational knowledge repositories
page_texts.10:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#review-scope]

### Review Scope

The PPR evaluates projects across multiple dimensions:
page_texts.11:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#business-value-realization]

#### Business Value Realization

- Achievement of stated business objectives and success criteria
- Return on investment (ROI) and financial performance analysis
- User adoption rates and satisfaction metrics
- Market impact and competitive advantage assessment
- Long-term sustainability and scalability validation
page_texts.12:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#technical-performance]

#### Technical Performance

- System performance against technical specifications and requirements
- Architecture quality and alignment with enterprise standards
- Security posture and compliance achievement
- Integration effectiveness and data quality
- Technical debt assessment and management
page_texts.13:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#process-effectiveness]

#### Process Effectiveness

- Governance process efficiency and value-add assessment
- Gate effectiveness and decision quality evaluation
- Communication effectiveness and stakeholder engagement
- Risk management effectiveness and issue resolution
- Change management effectiveness and adoption success
page_texts.14:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#organizational-learning]

#### Organizational Learning

- Skills development and knowledge transfer effectiveness
- Team performance and collaboration assessment
- Vendor and partner performance evaluation
- Tool and methodology effectiveness assessment
- Cultural and organizational impact evaluation

---
page_texts.16:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#gateway-flow]

### Gateway Flow

- **Input**: Completed projects 30-90 days after Product Go Live
- **Process**: Comprehensive retrospective evaluation and lessons learned capture
- **Output**: Project closure with documented lessons learned and improvement recommendations
- **Follow-up**: Integration of insights into governance processes and organizational knowledge
page_texts.17:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#exit-criteria]

### Exit Criteria

Projects completing PPR must demonstrate:

- Comprehensive assessment of business value realization
- Complete documentation of lessons learned and recommendations
- Stakeholder feedback collection and analysis
- Process improvement recommendations with implementation plans
- Formal project closure and knowledge transfer completion

page_texts.20:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#immediate-post-review-0-30-days]

### Immediate Post-Review (0-30 days)

- **Report Distribution**: Share PPR findings with stakeholders and leadership
- **Action Item Implementation**: Begin implementation of approved recommendations
- **Knowledge Base Updates**: Update organizational knowledge repositories
- **Process Updates**: Implement approved governance process improvements
- **Communication**: Communicate key insights to relevant teams and committees
page_texts.21:
[governance/governing-bodies/post-project-review.md#long-term-follow-up-30-180-days]

### Long-Term Follow-up (30-180 days)

- **Improvement Tracking**: Monitor implementation of recommended improvements
- **Trend Analysis**: Analyze patterns across multiple project reviews
- **Process Refinement**: Refine governance processes based on accumulated insights
- **Training Updates**: Update training materials and procedures based on lessons learned
- **Best Practice Evolution**: Evolve organizational best practices based on successful approaches
